text: The ESPRD provides direct financial support to rural households to lower the cost barriers for adopting safer construction practices. It disseminates standardized earthquake-resistant designs tailored for rural areas, ensuring that households and builders can implement proven structural solutions without incurring high engineering costs. The program also invests in training local construction artisans, aligning them with seismic design principles to improve construction quality. The initiative was piloted in Xinjiang in 2004 and expanded nationwide in 2007, demonstrating a successful model of localized implementation anchored by national policy direction.

metadata.solution_name: Earthquake Safety Project for Rural Dwellings (ESPRD)
